ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Recording weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
